summary: Iteration 158 - Commerce Center Hub Enhancement COMPLETE. All features verified: (1) GET /api/commerce-center/overview returns spotlight, category_mix, live_insights keys, (2) Commerce Center /commerce-center loads without blank screen, (3) Spotlight Deal visible with MacBook Pro M5 14 2026, (4) Category tabs (Alle, Elektronik, More, Gaming, Lifestyle) visible and clickable with proper filtering, (5) Commerce Pulse shows Insight cards and Category-Mix pills, (6) Existing modules (Flash Sales, Penny Auctions, Marketplace Highlights, Live Commerce) render correctly with proper empty states.
